text: {"reply":"Hi {first_name}, thank you for your message. Your eGFR was 84 mL/min/1.73m2. The lab's range lists 60 as the low end, so your number is above that. Your creatinine was 1 mg/dL, and the lab's range is 0.7 to 1.3, so it is within that range. Your clinician can talk with you about what these numbers mean for you, including how they relate to the ibuprofen you take. Please keep taking your medicines as they are for now, and your clinician will advise if anything should change. If you have new or worse symptoms, you can book a visit or call the clinic."}
